pir_sensor._comment: HC-SR501 PIR Motion Detector Module. Source: HC-SR501 Datasheet / BISS0001 IC Datasheet.

VCC._comment: Supply voltage: 4.5V-20V DC, nominal 5.0V (Source: HC-SR501 Datasheet)

OUT._comment: Output: 3.3V TTL High level via onboard 3.3V regulator (Source: HC-SR501 Datasheet). Max source current from BISS0001 is unrated for sustained loads, marked UNVERIFIED.

pir_sensor_5v._comment: 5V PIR Motion Sensor (Parallax #555-28027 style). Source: Parallax PIR Sensor Datasheet Rev 1.4.

VCC._comment: Supply voltage: 3.3V-5V DC, nominal 5.0V (Source: Parallax Datasheet Rev 1.4)

OUT._comment: Output: 5.0V logic High when supplied with 5V; max output current 23 mA (Source: Parallax #555-28027 Datasheet Rev 1.4)

relay_module._comment: 1-Channel 5V Relay Module with integrated driver transistor and flyback diode. Source: Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet & Keyes Relay Module Schematic.

VCC._comment: 5.0V DC operating voltage for relay coil (Source: Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet)

IN._comment: Digital input control signal. Active trigger drives base of onboard switching transistor. Drive current through opto/base resistor typically 2-4 mA, marked UNVERIFIED.

COM._comment: Common contact rated 10A 250VAC / 10A 30VDC (Source: Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet)

NO._comment: Normally Open contact rated 10A 250VAC / 10A 30VDC (Source: Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet)

NC._comment: Normally Closed contact rated 10A 250VAC / 10A 30VDC (Source: Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet)

relay._comment: Bare Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C Electromechanical Relay. Source: Songle SRD Datasheet.

coil_pos._comment: Coil terminal 1. Nominal coil voltage 5.0V, coil resistance 70 ohm (Source: Songle SRD datasheet)

coil_neg._comment: Coil terminal 2. Nominal coil power 0.36W, coil current ~71.4 mA at 5V (Source: Songle SRD datasheet)

COM._comment: Common contact rated 10A 250VAC / 30VDC (Source: Songle SRD datasheet)

NO._comment: Normally open contact rated 10A 250VAC / 30VDC (Source: Songle SRD datasheet)

NC._comment: Normally closed contact rated 10A 250VAC / 30VDC (Source: Songle SRD datasheet)

diode._comment: 1N4001 General Purpose Rectifier / Flyback Diode. Source: Diodes Inc. / Vishay 1N4001 Datasheet.

transistor._comment: 2N2222 NPN Bipolar Junction Transistor. Source: OnSemi 2N2222 Datasheet.

collector._comment: Collector terminal. Max continuous Ic = 800 mA (Source: 2N2222 Datasheet)
